relationshipsPage.title: Relationships
relationshipsPage.discoverZeroCandidates: AI found 0 candidates (check server logs for details)
relationshipsPage.tooManyRelationships: {{count}} relationships — use the filter above to browse
relationshipsPage.purposeBody: A relationship declares how two tables join, including across different sources. It is what lets a query, an agent, or the ERD traverse from one table to another instead of guessing a join — and joins are governed, so a role only traverses the relationships it holds rights to.
relationshipsPage.purposeAdd: Declare one by hand when you know the keys, or use Suggest with AI to propose candidates and accept or reject each.
relationshipsPage.erdHelpBody: Draws the registered tables and the relationships declared on this page as one graph, so a join path that crosses sources is visible at a glance. It reads the model rather than editing it: filter by domain and export the diagram as PNG or SVG.
relationshipsPage.modelingHelpBody: A workspace for settling a join before you declare it: run SQL against the registered tables, profile the columns, draw the join on a canvas, then promote the result into a real relationship without retyping it here.
relationshipsPage.suggestHelpBody: Scans the registered tables across domains for likely joins and lists them as candidates. Nothing is declared until you accept one, and a rejected candidate stays out of the list until you clear the rejections.
